_about: App links (Moses, 27 Oct 2026): links to these pages open the app when it's installed, else the website as before. The source for client/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json (Android App Links) and apple-app-site-association (iPhone Universal Links): change this file, then run `npm run app:links` and commit both. Certificate fingerprints and the Team ID are public (anyone can read them on the website), never secrets. Where to find each: docs/05-runbook.md, App links.
